title: Appointed as Assistant
original: When I first became a Candleholder, it took me three whole months to finish reading all the literature in the Sui Regulator's library. The paperwork you have piled up here... is no less impressive in size. I will have time to familiarize myself with my duties, right?

title: Appointed as Assistant
original: When I first became a Candleholder, it took me three whole months to finish reading all the literature in the Sui Regulator's library. The paperwork you have piled up here... is no less impressive in size. I will have time to familiarize myself with my duties, right?

title: Talk 1
original: Doctor? Let me join you for a walk... Oh, it's just Kroos and Mr. Nothing said they would take me around to introduce myself to all the operators on the landship. They've been very warm, much more so than when we first met... Wait, what? You're inspecting the entire ship today?

title: Talk 1
original: Doctor? Let me join you... Oh, Kroos and Mr. Nothing said you'd take me around for a 'bai shan men' today to meet all the operators on the landship. They've been very warm, much more so than when we first met... Hold on, are you going to tour the entire ship?

title: Talk 2
original: My father forged these blades for me. 'Drive out the shadows of the Feranmut and all the people's troubles.' A Candleholder's work is not so simple that we can manage it with force alone... Um, of course, I've also been practicing my kung fu every day!

title: Talk 2
original: My father forged these blades for me in Yumen himself. 'Exorcise the shadows of the Feranmuts, and ameliorate the plague on our land.' A Candleholder's work is not so simple that we can manage it with force alone... Um, of course, I've also been training as diligently as ever.

title: Talk 3
original: Yes, I do know Lin Qingyan. We held different titles, serving the Sui Regulator and the Central Judicial Office respectively. I've had my doubts about Rhodes Island before I arrived, and my time spent here has only doubled those suspicions. That being said, I shan't pry into the matters that 'Operator Leizi' is investigating.

title: Talk 3
original: Yes, I do know Lin Qingyan. We held different titles, serving the Sui Regulator and the Central Judicial Office respectively. I've had some doubts about Rhodes Island both before and after I arrived here. That being said, I shan't pry into the matters that 'Operator Leizi' is investigating.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: That Operator just now... was that Lord Wei's niece? No, I don't know her, but when I was little, my father told me to learn from her example. Not long ago, we discovered that Miss Ch'en resigned her position with the Lungmen Guard Department. Father did not say anything to me that day. Thinking back, I indeed find her admirable.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: That woman just now... was that Lord Wei's niece? No, I don't know her, but when I was little, my father told me to learn from her example. We later discovered that Miss Ch'en resigned her position. Father did not say anything to me that day. Thinking back, I indeed find her admirable.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: My father sent me to Dahuang in hopes that I would reflect upon my mistakes and improve as a man. Indeed, one should avoid deviating from the proper path. But perhaps my father's meaning runs deeper... Decades ago, he and the Grandmaster worked all night on a blade at the Sword Forge, making them late for work the following morning. Hmm... It may be that Father hates to see the flame in my heart snuff out.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: My father sent me to Dahuang in hopes that I would improve myself. But decades ago, he and the Grandmaster worked all night forging a blade at the Sword Forge, making them late for work the following morning. Of course, one should avoid deviating from the proper path, but I think my father wanted me to hold on to that spirit.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I'll keep an eye on the siblings, but I can't simply stand by and watch as Nian plays mahjong. Doctor, you've seen those exaggerated metal casts of hers. She conjures them as effortlessly as she blinks. Don't you think she's... just a little obnoxious? I can tell you're not playing dumb. That's the trickiest part.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I'll keep an eye on the siblings, but I can't simply stand by and watch when Nian plays mahjong. You've seen those exaggerated casts that Nian conjures up, and you think she's... only a little obnoxious? You're not playing dumb. That's the trickiest part.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: On-deck capture the flag is no doubt a competition of athletic ability. I was the first to climb onto the bridge, but the Vulpo lady riding her staff breezed past me to snatch the flag. That is blatant cheating, Doctor. How could you accuse me of being too competitive and unsportsmanlike?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: On-deck capture the flag is a challenge of mobility. Even though I was the first to climb onto the bridge, the Vulpo lady rode her staff and breezed past me to snatch the flag... Doctor, that is blatant cheating. How could you accuse me of being too competitive and unsportsmanlike?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: This is a handbook that all Candleholders keep on their person. I did record some observations about you, Doctor. I'm very sorry. But for what it's worth, I am now sure of one thing: You are the guiding post of this ship, and you are indeed ordinary. I will shred those pages, and I will ensure your safety.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: This is a handbook that all Candleholders keep on their person. Yes, I recorded some observations about you... I'm very sorry, Doctor, but for what it's worth, I am now sure of one thing: You are the guiding post of this ship, and you are indeed ordinary. I will shred those pages, and I will ensure your safety.

title: Idle
original: The Feranmuts breathe with this vast land, and the Candleholder walks into the long night.

title: Idle
original: The beast walks with the generous earth, as the Candleholder walks into the long night...

title: Onboard
original: Doctor, I am Zuo Le. The number of proxies aboard Rhodes Island has almost exceeded that of those in Yan. The Sui Regulator should have sent someone here long ago. In fact, it has been some time since we sent you an official notice, but it would seem your company may have forgotten to reply?

title: Onboard
original: Doctor, I am Zuo Le. The number of proxies aboard Rhodes Island has almost exceeded that of those in Yan. The Sui Regulator should have sent someone here long ago. In fact, it has been some time since we sent you an official notice, but it would seem your company may have forgotten to reply?

title: Watching Battle Record
original: For a pharmaceutical company to have so competently recorded and analyzed battle records… This is nigh unimaginable.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: To think that a pharmaceutical company has made such a competent analysis of battle records.

title: Promotion 1
original: My sincerest apologies, in my capacity as the mandarin, I'm afraid I cannot accept any form of 'promotion' from Rhodes Island... Ahem, what I mean is... we will forgo the titles, but I can accept the other benefits.

title: Promotion 1
original: My sincerest apologies, in my capacity as the mandarin Zuo Le, I'm afraid I cannot accept any form of 'promotion...' Ahem, what I mean is... we will forgo the titles, but I can accept the other benefits.

title: Promotion 2
original: Each megastructure coursing through Catastrophes has a meaning unique to itself. Shangshu transferred its mountains and waterscapes to its nomadic cities, while Yumen fends off sandstorms with its Wind Aegis. And so, what of Rhodes Island? On what convictions do you sail?

title: Added to Squad
original: I hope my meager assistance will prove fruitful.

title: Added to Squad
original: I hope my meager assistance will prove fruitful.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: To the right men, give the right jobs, enlist the talent, and forsake the snobs. I, Zuo Le, shall do my very best.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: To choose the right man for the job is a virtue, to choose a talent is more virtuous still. I, Zuo Le, shall do my very best.

title: Depart
original: The arrow has been nocked. Do not hesitate.

title: Depart
original: The arrow has been nocked, why hesitate?

title: Begin Operation
original: The thrust of a blade takes no shape, take no comfort that it lies sheathed.

title: Begin Operation
original: The thrust of a blade takes no shape, take no comfort that it lies stowed.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: From here on, your words are my command.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: From here on, your wish is my command.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: The situation is complicated, I shall improvise and adapt.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: The more complicated the situation, the simpler it is for me to act.

title: Deployment 1
original: When chaos abounds, tugging a single thread can pull the entire net.

title: Deployment 1
original: When chaos abounds, the most minute adjustment can change everything.

title: Deployment 2
original: Not even a stirring of grass will go overlooked.

title: Deployment 2
original: Not even the slightest stirring of grass will go overlooked.

title: In Battle 1
original: Go no further, this road is closed.

title: In Battle 1
original: Go no further, this road is closed.

title: In Battle 2
original: Such violence will not be tolerated!

title: In Battle 2
original: How dare you?!

title: In Battle 3
original: All balance held by the orders of Yan. All beasts hunted by the sons of man!

title: In Battle 3
original: Let there be order in Yan, and may Heaven safeguard our hunt.

title: In Battle 4
original: Tiny may a candle be, it shall drive out the darkest night!

title: In Battle 4
original: Even the shortest candle may exorcise the longest dark of night!

title: 4-star Result
original: Seeking total victory in peril. You are truly of extraordinary talent and courage.

title: 4-star Result
original: Seeking total victory in peril. You are truly of extraordinary talent and courage.

title: 3-star Result
original: A unit never takes the same formation, as water never takes the same shape. Such extraordinary planning and execution... Doctor, I cannot fathom your past.

title: Sub 3-star Result

title: Operation Failure
original: The Sui Regulator has contingencies for all possible outcomes. Leave the cleanup to me. Don't worry, my qinggong is good. I'll catch up.

title: Operation Failure
original: The Sui Regulator has contingencies for all possible outcomes, of course. Leave the cleanup to me. I have good qinggong. I'll catch up.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: I've lived in tents, and I've slept in fields. I'm not particularly demanding.

title: New Year's blessing
original: The northern mandarins are busy, just as farmers have little time for leisure... My duties have me traveling all across Yan. The Yanese are always busy, but this time of year, they come together to eat, to beat the drums, and to enjoy their reunions... The shadows have yet to fade, but likewise, the fireworks will never cease.

original: Good timing. You must have something to discuss with me. Yes and no?

title: Birthday
original: I was a fairly mischievous boy. I once leapt into a sand wheel in Yumen, nearly costing me my life. It was my birthday, so my father had me wear this mask for the entire day. Happy birthday, Doctor. Rhodes Island won't be stopping, but would you like to hop off for a look? Don't worry, I'll fly you back.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Londinium, Gran Faro, Trimounts... Rhodes Island has played a role in many crises. The Sui Regulator knows that you are not a simple pharmaceutical company, of course, but you have been doing everything in your power to prevent invisible disasters. And so you may stand shoulder-to-shoulder with us.
